A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Frequently asked questions

What should I include in a support report?+

Include a timestamp with timezone, request ID, model ID, HTTP status and a minimal reproduction. Remove API keys, personal data and private input content.

A generation timed out. Should I retry?+

Check the existing request or job status first. A timeout does not prove the generation was never started.

Where do I contact the RunBridge team?+

Official support channels will be published when account access opens. This preview does not submit tickets or send messages.
